root.name: Scandinavian Defense: Kádas Gambit
root.moves: 1. e4 d5 2. exd5 Nf6 3. d4 c6 4. dxc6 e5

overview: Black gambits further with 3...c6 4.dxc6 e5, going two pawns down for open lines and a lead in development. White can give the material back and simply develop. The play is open and tactical, with Black's compensation doubtful.

white_ideas.idea: Take the pawns and develop with Nf3
Exchange queens to reach an endgame up material
Return the material for safety if needed

typical_structures.structure: Open centre with White ahead in material

character.notes: Forcing lines and tactics where Black is behind.

gambit.notes: White can keep the c6 and d5 pawns in the main line.

soundness.notes: The Kadas Gambit is considered unsound for Black.

approach.notes: Rarely played at a high level.

character.reason: Black gives two pawns for open lines, so it is tactical.

gambit.reason: Black gives pawns that White can keep.

soundness.reason: The extra pawns tell and strong players avoid it.

approach.reason: Strong players hardly ever play it.
